rules: Changing locale changes only presentation strings.
Lodging IDs and Night choice IDs stay locale-neutral and exact.
Money cost, housing assignment, next-day Energy and next-day effects remain authoritative definitions values.
Localization lookup writes no gameplay Save field.
NightFlow phase identity is never translated in state.
School and Foreman Night choices keep their existing mechanics and ownership.
